name: Mandem in Disguise AI Trend: Turn Your Friends Into the Mandem
blurb: The mandem in disguise trend flips a photo of friends into a squad of masked guys: one quick flash, and every person stands in the same spot in a black balaclava, a black puffer jacket and a tracksuit.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text:
A viral "mandem in disguise" reveal video made from [Image 1], vertical 9:16. Start on the photo. A quick flash, and every person is now a guy in a black balaclava, black puffer and plain black joggers, same pose, same place.

[Image 1] is a group photo of friends. Before the flash, every person is exactly as in [Image 1]: copy the exact face of each person from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any glasses or freckles), their own clothes, their place in the group and their pose. Never blend their faces: each face stays the same until the flash, so their friends recognize them at once. Keep the place, the background, the light and the framing of [Image 1]; if the photo is wider than 9:16, extend the background naturally.

0-3 s: the photo comes alive: the friends hold their group photo pose, blink, smile and shift a little, as if a friend is taking the picture.
3-3.4 s: a bright white camera flash fills the whole frame.
3.4-10 s: the same place, the same light, the same framing. Every person is now a guy, a grown man of about the same height, in exactly the same spot and the same pose as the person who stood there (a hand on a hip stays on the hip, a crouch stays a crouch). Each one wears a plain black knitted balaclava that covers the whole head and face except one opening for the eyes, a plain black hooded puffer jacket, plain black cotton joggers with no marks at all and plain all-black trainers with no marks. No hair shows. Through the eye opening each one has the eye color, eyebrows and skin tone of the person who stood in that spot. Exactly as many people as in [Image 1]: nobody added, nobody missing. They stay calm and still, as if posing for the same group photo: a slow nod, a straight look into the lens, one tugs at his jacket zip. The camera pushes in slowly.

The disguise is a fashion joke and nothing more: plain black clothes with no logo, no brand mark, no stripes, no crest, no number and no text anywhere. Hands stay empty, relaxed or in the pockets: no weapon, no knife, no bat, no bag, no hand signs, no smoke, no money. Nobody runs, fights, threatens or poses aggressively. Never change anyone's skin tone or ethnicity. Grown adults only. One head per person, five fingers on each hand. No text, no captions, no stickers, no logos, no watermark.
Audio: a camera shutter click and a quick whoosh on the flash, then a deep, slow bass beat. No singing, no speech.
